Hello,

Your message came through empty, just the signature, so I want to make sure I answer the right thing.

If it is still about the power supply: the voltage selector is the small red switch under the right-hand side of the unit. Set it to 115V on 110V mains, 230V on 220V mains, and check it before you plug anything in.

For a hands-on walkthrough, our Discord is the fastest place: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Post there and mention @nullhashrate (JD). Guides and firmware are at https://harlolabs.com.

Just reply here with what you need and I will sort it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
